summary: Config-only verification of /app/frontend/app.json for Android APK update issue. All three checks passed: (1) Static JSON is valid; expo.version='1.0.2', expo.android.versionCode=3 (int), expo.ios.buildNumber='3' (str), expo.android.package='com.smartkitchenai.app', expo.ios.bundleIdentifier='com.smartkitchenai.app'. (2) `npx expo config --type public --json` resolves without error and returns the same values (SDK 57.0.0). (3) Smoke: Expo web preview loads, login with chef@cucina.ai / CucinaSmart2026 succeeds (routes /login -> /onboarding), onboarding-skip testID works and lands on /oggi home. app.json change does not break the bundle. NOTE: native APK cannot be built here; version bump correctness for Play Store install-over-update can only be validated end-to-end via an actual Android build.
action_items: After Android APK 1.0.2 (versionCode 3) is built, install it on top of the previously-installed 1.0.1 APK (same package com.smartkitchenai.app) to verify update-over-install works. If user still had the old com.emergent.appbuilder.caeb4l package installed, they must uninstall it first because it is a different application id.

critical_code_review_comments: app.json version bump is correct: versionCode 3 > 2 (previous 1.0.1 build) satisfies Android's monotonic-increase requirement.
iOS buildNumber correctly kept as a string ('3') per Expo schema; Android versionCode correctly an integer (3).

context_for_next_testing_agent: app.json now has version 1.0.2, android.versionCode 3, ios.buildNumber '3', package/bundleId 'com.smartkitchenai.app'. Web preview + login + onboarding-skip flow confirmed working after the config change. The install-over-update behavior itself must be verified on device after a fresh EAS/local Android build (out of scope for this sandbox).
rca_of_issue: Original bug: new APK build (1.0.1) did not update the installed app. Two root causes were addressed by main agent: (a) missing/unincremented android.versionCode - Android requires strictly increasing versionCode to allow install-over-update; (b) applicationId change (com.emergent.appbuilder.caeb4l -> com.smartkitchenai.app) which makes the new APK a separate application from Android's perspective, so it installs alongside instead of replacing. Fix: app.json now sets version 1.0.2, versionCode 3, buildNumber '3', and unifies package/bundleId as com.smartkitchenai.app. Verified statically and via expo config. Final on-device validation requires a real Android build.
